Leveraging an all-new aerodynamic inspired design, the ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 4090 Trinity OC utilizes the world’s most advanced gaming GPU powered by the NVIDIA Ada Lovelace architecture and DLSS 3. Using cutting-edge cooling technologies derived from the flagship model, the Trinity OC packs the punch to offer gamers the needed blistering FPS in the latest titles.
